text:
devops_rachel: Quick check — after yesterday's TF apply I saw model-server pods in model-configs ns get SIGTERM and restart when we flipped a feature flag. We used to hot-reload flags. Is the TF change intentionally forcing pod restarts?

mike_infra: Which configmap name? We added a checksum annotation in the k8s module to force restart for secrets => might be related.

devops_rachel: configmap name is model-flags-global. Here's the pod template snippet from the deploy:

```
metadata:
  annotations:
    configChecksum/model-flags-global: "sha256:8f3a..."
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: model-server
        volumeMounts:
        - name: model-configs
          mountPath: /etc/model-configs
```

sasha_platform: We recently set `enable_config_hash = true` in the TF module for extra safety on global config changes. That updates pod template to trigger rollout on change. Alexa, runtime expected behaviour?

alexa_runtime: Runtime watches files under /etc/model-configs/<model>/flags.json and supports hot-swap. We don't require pod restart for per-model flags. However if the TF change adds a checksum annotation on the pod template, that will intentionally change the template and K8s will SIGTERM old pods and create new ones. So the behaviour you're seeing is consistent with the annotation.

mike_infra: To add: the original PR toggled `hash_all_configmaps = true`. That was intended to ensure any config change is rolled out (avoids drift), but yeah it's aggressive.

devops_rachel: OK makes sense. I'd prefer hot-reload for per-model flags but keep rollout for global defaults. Can we make the TF module scope the hash annotation to only configmaps labelled `global=true`?

sasha_platform: Yep we can add a conditional. I'll open a tiny PR: change module var `hash_on_label_selector` default empty -> "global=true" in our infra. Will test in staging first. :+1:

alexa_runtime: Another option: runtime can expose a readiness probe that waits for any in-progress reloads so rolling updates are smoother. Also we could add a small watcher fallback for subPath mounts — sample pseudo:

```
// runtime pseudo
watchFile(`/etc/model-configs/${MODEL}/flags.json`, () => reloadFlags())
```

mike_infra: I'll also revert `hash_all_configmaps` in the Canary stack and run a quick smoke: patching configmap should update flags without restarting pods.

deploy-bot: Rollout triggered: deployment/model-server (canary) — 1/1 updated — by @mike_infra

devops_rachel: thanks all. Ping me on the PR and I'll review fast. If PR blocks the rest of infra changes, mark it as opt-in for now. :eyes:
